# Beyz AI

> > Beyz AI is an AI-powered interview preparation platform offering real-time coaching, company-specific question banks, and meeting assistance for technical and behavioral interviews.

The platform specializes in interview preparation for top tech companies (Google, OpenAI, Goldman Sachs, Shopee) with AI-generated questions, system design practice, behavioral coaching using the STAR method, and real-time meeting assistance with transcription and translation capabilities.

## Key Topics

- AI Interview Assistant
- Real-time Coaching
- Interview Preparation
- System Design
- STAR Method
- Technical Interviews
- Behavioral Questions
- Mock Interviews
- Software Engineer Roles
- Product Manager Interviews
- LeetCode Practice
- Interview Questions Generator
- Meeting Assistant
- FAANG Interview Prep
- Career Preparation

## Core Platform & Tools

- [AI Interview Assistant](https://beyz.ai): Homepage: Real-time AI interview assistant with multilingual support
- [Interview Questions & Answers 2025](https://beyz.ai/interview-questions-and-answers): Company-specific interview questions hub for FAANG and top tech companies
- [AI Interview Questions Generator](https://beyz.ai/tools/interview-questions-generator): AI-powered tool to generate custom interview questions by role and industry
- [Real-Time Meeting Assistant](https://beyz.ai/meeting-assistant): AI meeting assistant with teleprompter, transcription, and translation

## Company-Specific Interview Guides

- [Google Interview Questions and Answers 2025](https://beyz.ai/interview-questions-and-answers/google): Google interview prep with coding, behavioral, and system design questions
- [OpenAI Interview Questions and Answers 2025](https://beyz.ai/interview-questions-and-answers/openai): OpenAI interview prep with ML, research engineer, and coding questions
- [Goldman Sachs Interview Questions and Answers 2025](https://beyz.ai/interview-questions-and-answers/goldman-sachs): Goldman Sachs interview prep for finance and software engineering roles
- [Shopee Interview Questions and Answers 2025](https://beyz.ai/interview-questions-and-answers/shopee): Shopee-specific interview prep with questions, answers, and system design
